hints.label: nudge
hints.text: A test that passes alone and fails in company is not random; something outlives a test. Look for what one test can leave behind for the next.

hints.label: pointer to the signal
hints.text: Run `pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_pricing.py::test_default_tax` alone, then after test_zero_tax_when_configured. Check what shop/*.py keeps at module level, and what the Cart constructor's default argument is.

hints.label: near-solution
hints.text: Two kinds of shared state: module-level dicts mutated by tests (reset them around every test, e.g. an autouse fixture, or make them instance state) and a mutable default argument in Cart (`notes=[]` is created once and shared by every Cart). Also one test relies on another test having run first; give it its own setup. Do not skip or delete tests.
